test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The price of fuel decreases by 45%, 35% and 30% in three successive months, but increases by 45% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take initial price = 100

Apply multipliers ⇒ 100 × 0.55 × 0.65 × 0.70 × 1.45

= 100 × 0.3631375 = 36.31375

Net change = 36.31375 − 100 = −63.68625%

**∴ Answer = 63.69% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −45%, −35%, −30%, +45%

**Formula used:**

Final value = Initial × product of multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial price = 100

⇒ After 1st: 100 × 0.55 = 55

⇒ After 2nd: 55 × 0.65 = 35.75

⇒ After 3rd: 35.75 × 0.70 = 25.025

⇒ After 4th: 25.025 × 1.45 = 36.28625

⇒ Net change = 36.28625 − 100 = −63.71375

⇒ ≈ −63.71%

**∴ The correct answer is 63.71% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Use multipliers: (1 − p/100) for decrease, (1 + p/100) for increase

Multiplicative Effect

Changes are applied sequentially, not added

Shortcut Tip

Assume base value = 100 for easy calculation

Rounding Rule

Round final percentage to two decimal places
